今個夏天食平D粵
programme.desc: 最後一集，主持決定留守街市與街坊互動及送禮。肥媽以便宜價錢做出貴價海鮮餐，同時為西班牙辣肉腸配上不同材料烹調出新款菜式，還煮出兩款與中秋節有關的菜式。肥媽為了感謝街坊的支援，做出甚麼非常貼心的事？

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 肺動脈高壓有五大分類，早期症狀有胸悶、易喘，嚴重時更會出現昏厥、肺積水。右心導管檢查能精準檢測肺動脈內壓力，呼吸系統科醫生細談治療目標，以及針對不同病情采用的治療方案。健力運動員李健禧早前孤身一人赴土耳其出戰健力大學生盃，成功挑戰不可能，奪冠歸來！他講解何謂健力運動，並重提首次參戰香港健力錦標賽便打破紀錄的往事，更樂於從健力重量的提升見證自己的進步。「睇餸食飯」，Annie示範「簡易版豬手薑醋」。

programme.title: BB要健康粵
programme.desc: 不少人相信茹素有益健康，營養師卻擔心嬰幼兒吃素或會引致營養不良。有助腦部發展的DHA多從海產類食物吸收，有甚麼素食能夠代替？嘉賓潘芳芳、曹永廉、容羨媛又可會反對小朋友茹素？烹調嬰幼兒食物時，有人或認為不應下油；營養師指出油分必需，是何原因？中醫師提到孩子於三歲前不宜「太補」，並帶來相關飲食宜忌。衛生署資料顯示香港每五名小學生便有一人過重，中醫師細說小朋友致肥體質及改善湯水；營養師亦會分享營養食譜。

programme.title: 語你同行三十載粵
programme.desc: 「深耕三十載 ，語你譜新篇」，教育局、語文教育及研究常務委員會(語常會)三十年來，致力協助在香港推動兩文三語。節目由星級藝員梁凱晴(Carina)、焦浩軒、語常會學生語文大使Anisah Hussain擔綱演出，述說當局如何透過政策藍圖、撥款、教學支援、多元化活動等各方面，讓本港市民，尤其是中小學生提升語文水平，進一步掌握兩文三語的運用。

programme.title: 老表，你好hea！#22粵PG
programme.desc: 利亞在鼓勵下參加拳賽，成功贏得冠軍。尤田逼小報告任臥底，阻止拉高與芭芭拉在一起。專門捧新人做立法會議員的拉美到訪在野辦事處，邀在野及靜雯加入政黨，並答應助靜雯說服秋水。高音警告利亞不要纏著林雪。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 方德證券獨家呈現:交易先機粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子因為態度懶散而被媽媽責罵。但小丸子依然故我，繼續以懶散的態度渡日。爸爸經常在晚上喝酒及吃小食。某一晚，爸爸分了一些小食給小丸子吃。小丸子覺得很美味，於是替爸爸斟酒作為報答。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 透過AI技術，能將冗長文字轉化為簡潔、清晰的概念圖，甚至是有趣的漫畫，令學習趣味倍增。這次「AI小學堂」，嘉賓除了示範以AI生成「光合作用」流程圖，還傳授加入清晰指令的竅門。他更提醒大家要保持批判思考精神，仔細檢視生成圖表可會有出錯。「開心SHARE」以「我和好朋友的難忘回憶」為題，有小朋友投稿分享參與單車百萬行、到主題樂園坐纜車等事情。主持們亦暢談相關經歷，原來皓誼姐姐是刺激機動設施的愛好者。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 雖然失去了公主的力量，風花姊妹仍能借助白之女王的力量，變回花騎士。在花騎士掩護下，阿源等人終於闖入巨塔，與史納樂隊對峙。花騎士縱使實力橫強，面對史納樂隊仍然處於下風，就在這時，阿源三人想到一件事……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 週年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 康城一個兩房新盤，以奶茶色配襯原裝傢俱，同時用不同層次，擴闊視覺空間，效果如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#59粵
programme.desc: 《當年好聲音》首輪淘汰賽即將舉行，「人氣王」MOMO在拜神儀式上出招搶嘉冰風頭，龔喜卻助嘉冰成為焦點。MOMO因意外當眾出醜，遂設計陷害嘉冰，令她失聲。比賽前一晚，龔喜想盡辦法助嘉冰恢復聲音，惟嘉冰唱高音仍力不從心，唐芯等人紛紛向嘉冰獻計。比賽當天，嘉冰唱至高音時，只好以唐芯提議的方法化解危機……嘉冰雖未能盡展實力，卻仍獲得高分，更成為該回合的MVP。嘉冰含淚感激支援，最終卻作出令人震驚的決定……

programme.title: 澳門上葡京綜合度假村呈獻：璀璨之城#15粵PG
programme.desc: 尚利鋒集團主席官志琛在澳門雄霸一方，這商界巨人安排兩子官孝賢、官孝君，出任集團聯席行政總裁，平起平坐。孝賢一直視孝君為眼中釘，為瓦解孝君和其夫人王雪瑩的強大團夥，孝賢宣佈與香港檢控官洪海允成婚。海允與雪瑩本是閨密，出身於十月初五街，但雪瑩為嫁入豪門，奪去海允的情人孝君。孝賢就是要利用海允心中的仇恨，化成攻擊孝君夫婦的利器。在家族各人看似充滿機心的環境中，孝君卻堅守正義，奮力抵抗著孝賢的步步進逼……

programme.title: 與廚同行 家樂牌專業餐飲呈獻：美食強人粵
programme.desc: 西多士衝出香港，保留傳統技法的同時，引入嶄新口味，這集一探其他大灣區地方的代表。來自番禺的元祖級「漏奶華」西多，切開麵包湧出爆漿煉奶，配合鋪面華田粉，勁邪惡！「煉奶控」陳山聰憶起童年美味回憶，卻與嘉欣似有代溝？甜度喜好再成討論焦點，食店「規矩」多多亦掀起熱議。澳門小店則以流心鹹蛋黃殺出重圍，創出鹹甜口味的人氣西多。麵包要炸到香脆不油膩，講求不少技巧，名廚點出店家用心之處，卻對其最終得分感到意外？

programme.title: 武則天#15粵普
programme.desc: 媚娘在御書房力陳德妃後事，令韋妃警覺其威脅。李佑身亡使世民悔恨；李淳風卜出「女主武氏」預言，危機直指媚娘。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

老婆大人#20粵
programme.desc: (大結局)法庭上，希敏承認受情緒影響傷害了昕昕，國光為了讓希敏脫罪，向她坦承愛意，並承認曾作假證供。昕昕不諱言憎恨及妒忌希敏，遂設計搶走國光。當她聽到國光說只愛希敏一人時，大受打擊。詠詩和德雲結婚日，知道德雲沒買鑽戒，以及二人將到深圳布吉度蜜月而非泰國布吉時，即時拒婚。昕昕返大馬，亞基趕到機場向她求婚……寶怡返港，帶智雄到埋下草莓的地方，竟發現長出新的草莓來。寶怡笑說奇蹟果然出現，智雄心有決定……

programme.title: 老表，你好hea！#22粵PG
programme.desc: 利亞在鼓勵下參加拳賽，成功贏得冠軍。尤田逼小報告任臥底，阻止拉高與芭芭拉在一起。專門捧新人做立法會議員的拉美到訪在野辦事處，邀在野及靜雯加入政黨，並答應助靜雯說服秋水。高音警告利亞不要纏著林雪。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#218粵
programme.desc: 花發現義的魅力驚人，女性們處處為義開方便之門，更對他眉目傳情。花藉口分享相簿，實想了解義的過去，花發現義內藏有大量與女性的合照，明白義自少便已受女性歡迎。花愈看愈妒忌，更擔心義會被搶去，不禁悲從中來。

programme.title: 玉樓春#32粵普PG
programme.desc: 桃夭摔下台階小產，指責是月紅把自己推下去的。俊豪懷疑谷野有問題，谷野卻一直纏著滴珠。俊豪的部下被毒酒毒死，原來野狼還活著，俊豪被迫取消婚禮。玉樓要主持貴太妃喪儀，發現陪葬品流出市面，懷疑有人監守自盜。

programme.title: 社企達人粵
programme.desc: 社企用心經營生意之餘，透過發揮創意與開創潛能，達到社會目的。吳家樂、梁嘉琪、敖嘉年分別到三間社企，見識一門手藝及新一代「社企達人」。被遺忘的汽車零件，憑復興五金機械技術變時尚家品，飛機零件變沙發見過未？家樂親身到廢車場尋寶！理髮店竟有薰腳服務，這間社企聘請智障及精神病康復者，提供一站式服務，嘉琪享用貼心服務後讚好！嘉年天未光到蔬果批發加工場，與智障及精神病康復者員工一起將蔬果切粒刨皮，有甚麼體會？

programme.title: 社企達人粵
programme.desc: 安德尊、區永權、邵珮詩與胡諾言尋訪不同社企，感受在營運過程所肩負的使命。視障者在生活遇到障礙，透過高科技聲音導航與社會接軌，更可擔任收銀及找續工作，打破社會侷限。珮詩到製衣工場，見識中年和退休者重新傳承寶貴製衣技術，堅持香港製造，助年輕設計師圓夢。大王親訪長者家居，體驗為銀髮族提供一站式家居裝修服務。社企聘請不同能力的殘疾人士製作餸菜包和日間院舍飯餐，胡仔與員工出車送餐，見證他們與社會融和的一面！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
細味文明粵英
programme.desc: 在阿爾卑斯山與普羅旺斯之間的薰衣草田、中世紀村莊、壯麗峽谷與山地高原，人們延續陶藝、芝士、香草、葡萄酒、菇菌與橄欖的傳統，也適應不斷轉變的氣候和鄉郊生活。從古堡到高地，都由自然、歷史與工藝共同塑造。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 不丹人相信, 他們的木面具能連結神與人, 令人正直善良地生活 蘊含不丹精神和靈魂的木面具代表著神的形象, 是不丹人的重要節慶策秋節中 宣揚佛教教義的表演裡不可或缺的元素

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: 歷史學家Bettany Hughes 再次踏上旅程，探索更多人類歷史上最引人入勝的故事，揭開世界各地鮮為人知的歷史和非凡文物。

programme.title: 胡說八道真情假期粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 四姊妹把臂出海享受陽光，並徇眾要求互揭私隱，胡杏兒還越洋致電黃智雯，假扮姊妹反目，智雯可會上當？及後她們欣賞露天電影，放映前大談各人專屬「功能」。胡定欣原來擅長為好姊妹拍攝沙龍，其中一張美照更為杏兒的婚姻牽紅線！定欣穿著性感服裝遊市集，令現場氣氛升溫。杏兒外遊亦不忘為好姊妹的幸福著想，送贈定欣愛神戒指，盼其姻緣早日降臨。旅程來到尾聲，四姊妹對著日落美景盡訴真情，定欣再次「喊包」上身，因何如此感觸？

programme.title: 兩個小生去Camping粵
programme.desc: 柏豪曾講過因為家室而顧慮增多，這次要於愛妻生日正日玩滑翔傘，心情更加複雜！放開過後，畏高的他在空中開小型演唱會亦不成問題！雙豪為三位女嘉賓搭建Glamping格局，鄧佩儀竟送「兩梳蕉」作回禮？柏豪決定揭開佩儀的片場真面目「報復」！Ben與王君馨、黃智雯先後合演情侶，難為他還成了智雯的情緒宣洩物件。拍劇期間，演員跟拍檔朝夕相對，眾人可會產生愛上對手難以抽離的感覺？此外，佩儀的「入戲牌」又是甚麼回事？

programme.title: 週六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 谷主汛文、瀅仴都害怕沉悶工作，拍檔凱文提到二人或許適合「數字遊民」的工作模式。這模式是指利用網路遙距工作並自由旅居，在新冠疫情期間因居家辦公而開始盛行。不少設計師、KOL等都已加入行列，峇裡島、清邁均是遊民們的熱門辦公地點。這種自由模式縱被視為「I人」天堂，但瀅仴認為背後需要高度自律；凱文則講述此模式對當地社會的不同影響。不過，當深入認識數字遊民是甚麼一回事後，汛文躍躍欲試，瀅仴卻堅稱不適合自己？

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 IV粵
programme.desc: 《警聲百二秒 IV》引領觀眾「上天下海」、甚至「穿梭過去未來」，並繼續以輕鬆有趣的系列表達方式，讓市民接收豐富的警隊資訊，說好香港警察故事。

programme.title: 福祿壽訓練學院粵PG
programme.desc: 其他面試者陸續登場演出，如有導師按燈，就會取代已入班的學生！超過一人按燈的話，選擇權更落在面試者手上。竟有人因祥師兄長得像其母而選他？另有學員入學一會兒便被踢走。自稱「行走的CD機」還反過來被福祿壽求教扮聲技巧？有女士扮演「光B」，祥師兄得知其身分後大吃一驚！選歌亦重要，「鴨脷洲霑叔」被福祿壽直指揀錯代表作，也有人唱出張敬軒難度作品時，三盞燈同告亮起！學員與導師齊集影班相，同時獲告知首輪訓練主題。

programme.title: 世界養生組織粵
programme.desc: 今時今日問10個人有什麼願望，9個人會答:身體健康！這些日子，疫症肆虐，人人都要增強抵抗力，才能與病毒共存；拉闊點看，人類平均壽命延長了，不好好保養自己等老了體弱多病的話，苦了自己也苦了家人，怎過意得去！

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵
programme.desc: 全新一輯《地球大神秘》，以探秘的角度及專業的手法，深入拆解世上各種不解謎團［Secret X］。［Secret X］代表未知、極致、禁忌，以及一切等待被發現真相的代號。透過揭開隱藏於挪亞方舟的終極奧秘，得以更瞭解貫穿世界一切事物的「神秘的禰」，從而在陷入亂局的這一刻，找到如何活得平安及豐盛，以及尋找到永恆不滅的主宰。

programme.title: 星光魔法粵日
programme.desc: 希娜邀請祭到訪荒鷲學園，米琪露也乘機混進去。喵姆亂用魔法導致出現重重機關，希娜以靈活身手救出琪沐沐，令祭得知其努力不懈的鍛鍊。看過希娜的星光魔法後，喵姆突然表示要跟她組成拍檔。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這次會展開「下肢肌力訓練」和「上肢肌肉訓練」，還要用上一個藥球？手和腳都做好熱身，隨即「WORKOUT 2GETHER」！進行原地大踏步，聽到指令就要舉手或蹲低。藥球放胸口前，先做雙腳交替向前跨步，再試試蹲下、舉球。這一節練習可提升大腿肌肉力量，走路時就更有力。然後集中鍛練上肢肌肉，雙手握著毛巾，趴下並模仿「超人」的動作。對摺毛巾放地上，雙膝跪在毛巾上爬行；再轉為坐著毛巾，並利用雙手力量移動身體。

programme.title: 動物超能力粵英
programme.desc: 動物王國裡充滿了擁有超能力的不可思議生物！節目每一集會以不同的主題呈現，以及由不同領域的專家帶來令人震驚的知識作講解。

programme.title: 安妮的童話粵日
programme.desc: 安妮暑假返到艾凡裡，得知露比病重，深受衝擊。她一邊撰寫小說《艾薇兒的贖罪》，一邊陪伴逃避死亡恐懼的露比。經歷退稿與內心掙扎後，安妮終於正視露比的痛苦，陪她傾訴遺憾與恐懼，送別好友走向天國。

programme.title: 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 香港，一個中西薈萃、新舊共融的國際都市，不論吃喝、玩樂、購物都多姿多采。節目中主持人會介紹最新的潮流資訊和生活熱話，為你發掘香港更精彩的一面，講究生活和追求時尚的你絕對不能錯過。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 《新聞透視》，每週專題報道多段香港以至國際的矚目新聞，聚焦港人最關心的民生話題，並邀請各界人士、學者、專家，一同深入探討箇中來龍去脈。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 渣打優先理財呈獻：Grand住去首爾粵
programme.desc: 高海寧、周嘉洛、朱敏瀚出發「Chill住遊」首爾。三人盛裝打扮歎摘星韓國料理，用脆片包裹魚片掛在樹枝上，擺盤已創意十足，慢煮十八小時的「1 」韓牛，朱仔大讚油脂平衡，做得出色。海寧獨自走進咖啡店，本打算一睹型男店員們以飽眼福，怎料最終陪她用餐的仍是朱仔和嘉洛。「開箱」盤浦洞酒店，房間可俯瞰江南核心地帶。再朝聖IU等眾星曾光顧的中韓餐廳，享用烤肉串與銅火鍋。壓軸前往吃海鮮，朱仔更表演用口剝蝦殼！

programme.title: 香港旅遊發展局呈獻：香港連場好戲粵
programme.desc: 《無間道》曾於舊油麻地警署取景，兩主持深入光影展，沉浸式感受警匪片情懷。動作導演林迪安細談設計動作場面的點滴，還編排一段追逐戲，展現香港狹窄街道特色。《旺角黑夜》一幕逃亡戲為花園街天橋注入都市浪漫，主持傳授打卡攻略，另會遊走啟德體育園新地標。港產動作片傳奇不得不提《英雄本色》，在新舊交融的中環街景回望「當年情」。槍戰、舌戰劇情同樣激昂，漫步添馬公園投入《寒戰》氛圍，再隨《三岔口》足跡探索美食街區。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
香港賽馬會特約：J Sport粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 黎清嵐受身為網球教練的爸爸啟蒙，踏上運動員道路，她細談父女關係與徵戰亞運經歷。壁球學生運動員趙彥正曾赴埃及集訓，有何得著？他暢談追夢起點與目標。亞運得獎港將參與巴士巡遊，跟市民分享喜悅。乒總訓練中心開幕，為本港乒壇發展寫下新一頁。匹克球亞巡賽結束，男單、混雙等戰況如何？高爾夫球公開賽，港將張雄熙奪亞。網球中巡賽、羽毛球公開賽將在港舉行，這集送上記招。另搜羅高階組銀牌足球賽、港隊出戰手球中超的戰報。

programme.title: 飛虎3壯志英雄#17粵PG
programme.desc: 杜文彬對抗毒劑研究進展緩慢很不滿，許森提出只要有過往的資料和資料，進展會大大加快。於是杜文彬帶許森前往P3實驗室，說起當年發生的事和已下落不明的蔡肇培。小魚病情突然惡化離世，令子樂大受打擊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.desc: 四姊妹把臂出海享受陽光，並徇眾要求互揭私隱，胡杏兒還越洋致電黃智雯，假扮姊妹反目，智雯可會上當？及後她們欣賞露天電影，放映前大談各人專屬「功能」。胡定欣原來擅長為好姊妹拍攝沙龍，其中一張美照更為杏兒的婚姻牽紅線！定欣穿著性感服裝遊市集，令現場氣氛升溫。杏兒外遊亦不忘為好姊妹的幸福著想，送贈定欣愛神戒指，盼其姻緣早日降臨。旅程來到尾聲，四姊妹對著日落美景盡訴真情，定欣再次「喊包」上身，因何如此感觸？

programme.title: 世界養生組織粵
programme.desc: 今時今日問10個人有什麼願望，9個人會答:身體健康！這些日子，疫症肆虐，人人都要增強抵抗力，才能與病毒共存；拉闊點看，人類平均壽命延長了，不好好保養自己等老了體弱多病的話，苦了自己也苦了家人，怎過意得去！

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 不丹人相信, 他們的木面具能連結神與人, 令人正直善良地生活 蘊含不丹精神和靈魂的木面具代表著神的形象, 是不丹人的重要節慶策秋節中 宣揚佛教教義的表演裡不可或缺的元素

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: 歷史學家Bettany Hughes 再次踏上旅程，探索更多人類歷史上最引人入勝的故事，揭開世界各地鮮為人知的歷史和非凡文物。

programme.title: 細味文明粵英
programme.desc: 在阿爾卑斯山與普羅旺斯之間的薰衣草田、中世紀村莊、壯麗峽谷與山地高原，人們延續陶藝、芝士、香草、葡萄酒、菇菌與橄欖的傳統，也適應不斷轉變的氣候和鄉郊生活。從古堡到高地，都由自然、歷史與工藝共同塑造。

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 熱血軍檢
programme.desc: 【安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！】以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中。當軍中黑暗勢力浮上台面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力、揭露真相。在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事。

programme.title: 裸婚時代
programme.desc: 【八年愛情遇上現實婚後生活秒變修羅場】劉易陽與童佳倩相戀八年，決定在懷孕之際不顧家境懸殊與雙方父母的強烈反對，選擇沒房、沒車、沒鑽戒、沒婚禮的「裸婚」。兩人原以為愛情足以抵擋現實，但婚後卻發現，與易陽父母同住的壓力、兩家價值觀的衝突，以及柴米油鹽的重擔正逐步侵蝕他們的浪漫。當理想被生活逼到牆角，這對一路走來的戀人，究竟能否守住最初的承諾，為愛打下一個真正的家？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 模範刑警
programme.desc: 【孫賢周攜手張勝祖，最強刑警搭檔追查冤案揭開真相！！】資深刑警姜道昌憑經驗與直覺，與只相信證據的天才刑警吳志赫成了新搭檔。兩人辦案風格迥異，從衝突到合作，逐漸建立默契。面對五年前女高中生遇害的案件出現新的疑點，兩人聯手出擊揭開掩蓋的真相，對抗試圖隱瞞冤案的權力與勢力找出真兇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 時光之城
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手樸敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 等待京道
programme.desc: 【樸敘俊回歸攜手《魷魚2》元志安《等待京道》譜十年宿命戀】十年後的重逢，讓李京道與徐智友再度陷入愛情的漩渦。曾是彼此初戀的兩人，如今一個是追尋真相的記者，一個是醜聞風暴中的名門繼承人。再見面時，他們早已不是年少時的模樣，卻依然在對方身上看見過去的自己。愛情與現實的距離，在一次次試探與退讓間拉扯，他們明知前方滿是荊棘，仍選擇再次並肩。

programme.title: 燦爛的風和海
programme.desc: 【賽車手失意澳門 邂逅冷豔策展人共度浪漫情緣】在燈火輝煌的攝影棚與璀璨奪目的澳門之間，廣告導演麥又歌為夢想與責任奔波，結識熱心單純的機車青年徐君樂，在彼此的陪伴下逐漸開啟封閉的心門。同時，賽車手韓俊豪在失利陰影與媒體質疑中掙扎，卻因邂逅神秘策展人陳嘉慧，而重新燃起追尋自我的勇氣。四人在工作、夢想與愛情的交織裡相遇，既面對現實的壓力，也學會傾聽心底的渴望。在陌生卻絢爛的城市裡，他們將一同經歷命運的考驗，找尋屬於自己的方向。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支援她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 女醫明妃傳
programme.desc: 【劉詩詩淡妝出鏡美出新高度，妙手仁心成明朝一代女國醫！！】女子地位低下的大明，不得從醫也難治隱疾。杭允賢從小耳濡目染，偷偷隨祖母學習中醫知識，不僅在學醫道路上面臨重重的困難和阻礙，更要面對封建禮教和世俗觀唸的衝擊。開創並建立女醫制度，從救人身體到救人靈魂，懸壺濟世、妙手仁心的名聲，得到普通百姓的讚揚和支援。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 完全省錢戀愛手冊
programme.desc: 【精打細算的戀愛，郭書瑤vs林子閎金錢價值觀保衛戰，有錢沒錢都要愛！！】不追求戀愛的節儉會計師上班族簡可可，平易近人做事俐落、個性率直又善良。碰上了花錢如流水的同事王海闊，是能力強、業界有名的王牌業務。對彼此逐漸動心的愛情，兩人的金錢價值觀卻大大不同，要如何在愛情與麵包做選擇呢?

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不捱打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends Minis
programme.desc: Get ready to watch Talking Tom and Friends at their cutest! Mini in size, but massive in fun, the Minis check out the day-to-day world of the friends we all know and love where they do the most ordinary things in the most extraordinary ways.

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: Domi Kids is a brand-new 3D animated musical series created by Leqing Media. With lively and engaging music, multiple characters bring to life the warm and joyful daily adventures of Domi and his family of five. The show features diverse themes, captivating stories, and vibrant scenes. A professional music production team ensures high-quality melodies, arrangements, and vocals, creating a delightful audiovisual experience for children. With positive and entertaining content, the series helps young kids learn about the world at an age-appropriate pace while supporting parents in making parenting easier and more enjoyable.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Misha, the Purple Cat
programme.desc: Misha is a very lively, alert cat. She is very interested in investigating everything going on around her, which means she has some very entertaining adventures with her friends. Many things can happen in Misha’s world; especially exciting adventures, mysterious investigations, hilarious competitions... all with a feeling of close friendship.

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger is a colorful and exciting 3D animated show full of music, dancing, and fun adventures! It follows BarryTiger and his lovable friends as they play, learn, and discover new things every day. With happy songs, cheerful characters, and amazing places to visit, each episode brings smiles and laughter. The music is made by real musicians, so every tune is catchy and sounds great! Get ready to sing along, move to the beat, and have a roaring good time with BarryTiger!

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Runaway Ankylosaurus
programme.desc: Andy and Jen discover a meteorite crater on Dino Island. But a grumpy old Ankylosaurus charges through their camp.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Ball
programme.desc: Bella and Lift have fun playing with their favourite red bouncy ball. It drops into the Ice Disco, giving Hettie the Yeti an idea for a bouncy dance!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Train Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is playing with his train set. Choo-choo! It's amazing! The squirrels are curious and want to know all about it. Duggee explains that it is a toy but it works exactly like a real train. Hennie arrives and she has a train too. The squirrels ask if they can play with it. You can't play with it; you can play IN it says Hennie.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Dancing Bug Badge
programme.desc: When a dancing bug lands on Duggee's head, he can't stop dancing. The Squirrels see that it's a tiny hillbilly bug with a fiddle. And what's more, he's got a band with him - the Hillbilly Bug Band.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Teamwork Badge
programme.desc: A box full of bits and pieces is delivered to the Clubhouse and the Squirrels are excited. Duggee and the Squirrels are going to have to work hard to put it all together. Time for a bit of teamwork.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Gua Rusa, Borneo
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch discovers his Halloween pumpkin isn't as big as the Grimbots' one, he goes in search of some fertilizer to help it grow.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Wind Power
programme.desc: It's a very windy day at the Go Jet Academy as Jetpad comes in to land, zooming past the academy's windfarm turbines. Meanwhile, in a field nearby, Grandmaster Glitch is teaching his grimbots a lesson all about wind power by trying to fly a giant kite. But as the kite is launched, the strong wind catches it and pulls Glitch up, up and away - and straight towards a huge spinning turbine!

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Laid Back Shane
programme.desc: Shane is having too much fun to stop and refuel. That is, until he runs out of coal and is stranded in the hot, red desert.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Moon Bow
programme.desc: Rainbow gets to experience the night for the first time.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Bench Blocked
programme.desc: When Sarah and Duck's favourite bench is in use, the pair find other things to do in the park.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Mayor Stan
programme.desc: Myrtle declares Stanley Mayor for a day. He soon finds there is a dance class and new barn to open with lots of ribbon cutting, and he even fits in making a Bowling alley.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Sleepover
programme.desc: Stanley helps Hettie with a sleepover at the museum for some of the children. They do a treasure hunt and a night-time picnic, but antics ensue when they clean up after themselves.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Like Jellyfish, Because they Jiggle
programme.desc: The funny little animals talk us through all their favourite creatures.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S01 - It's time to ride a bike
programme.desc: JoJo wishes Gran Gran could join her on a bike ride in the park, so Gran Gran decides to fix her old bicycle. After a good clean and fix-up, she's ready to ride!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Space
programme.desc: Mackenzie, Jack and Rusty are playing as astronauts on a mission to Mars, but during their journey, Mackenzie keeps going missing and no one knows why, not even Mackenzie.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Smoochy Kiss
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want Dad all to themselves and will not let Mum have a smoochy kiss. They try to hide him all around the house, but Mum is desperate to spend a little romance time with her husband.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dirt
programme.desc: Judo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Collecting Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is cleaning his biscuit tin collection, one of the many things he collects. The squirrels are inspired to make their own collections. They busy themselves doing the collecting bit, and then display their precious things in the clubhouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Yoga Badge
programme.desc: It's one of those days. The squirrels have arrived and they're all a little bit ... hyped up with bundles of energy. Things are starting to get a bit frantic, and Duggee needs to calm them all down. Fortunately, he has his Yoga Badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Making Friends Badge

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Dentist
programme.desc: Charley can't wait to show Dentist Maisy his wobbly tooth!

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Go to the Moon

First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, they're on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodri's front door.

First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - I'm Hungry
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Potato Time
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Song of Peace
programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with, Hennie bounces around in new dance shoes, and Happy loves water as much as Roly loves potatoes!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ladybird's Gameshow
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Listen
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-­Laa and Po take it in turns to listen to music through a pair of headphones. The Teletubbies love dancing to the music they hear.

programme.title: Teletubbies Ready Steady Go! S01 - Peekaboo
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are back together like you've never seen them before!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Puppets
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Turtle Boy
programme.desc: Bingo finds a toy turtle at the playground and wants to take him home, but Dad says it's not the right thing to do.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Onesies
programme.desc: When mum's sister Brandy comes over for a visit, she brings the kids onesies as a present, which has an unexpected effect on Bingo.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Tradies
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo hide under the house and spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard, wondering what they're up to.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Granny Mobile
programme.desc: Muffin is playing Grouchy Granny at a garage sale, making Dad push her on an old mobility scooter, but when a real Grouchy Granny wants to buy it, Muffin won't budge.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Grudge Match
programme.desc: Raul, the Brazilian tank engine, wants to beat Thomas in a game. But Raul's super-competitive nature soon gets him into trouble.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Diesel Glows Away
programme.desc: When notorious Diesel hides from the other engines, his plans backfire and he gets a surprise on Sodor.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Laid Back Shane
programme.desc: Shane is having too much fun to stop and refuel. That is, until he runs out of coal and is stranded in the hot, red desert.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jet Academy: Stop Those Superweeds
programme.desc: Some fast-growing plants that don't belong on Academy Island are in danger of taking over. Can the Go Jetters stop the superweed from damaging the Academy and Grim HQ?

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - The Blarney Stone, Ireland
programme.desc: Glitch finally pushes the Grimbots too far with his rudeness, prompting them to go on strike. Glitch seeks help from Kyan - but Kyan has his own problems, as he's worried about speaking in front of a crowd for his upcoming show and tell. Glitch thinks of a solution to both their problems: they'll travel to Barney Castle in Ireland, near where his Great Aunt Cliodhna lived, and find the Barney Stone. It is said to give the gift of the gab to all who kiss it, making them brilliant at talking to pe

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jet Academy: Around The World In 80 Days
programme.desc: It's a rainy day and the team are stuck inside, so Foz reads them his favourite book: Around the World in 80 Days by Jules Verne. The Go Jetters imagine they are characters from the story as they listen to a tale of travel by train, boat and even elephant. Will 'Phileas Foz' and his friends make the trip in time?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Swoppiton Speed Scramble
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo join the big cross-town race with plans to win. But how can they stay ahead when they have to keep stopping and swopping to help other racers in trouble?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Flap Away Home
programme.desc: When a lost bird takes a liking to Bo, it is up to Mojo to fly it home. But it's a stormy trip, and Bo will need to do some flying of his own!

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Evil Peamobile Goes Rogue
programme.desc: Evil Pea adds a voice control feature to her Evil Peamobile, but when she calls it a nitwit, the car decides to teach her a lesson.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Captain Pak Choi Returns
programme.desc: Supertato and Carrot are in a race against Captain Pak Choi to find buried treasure on Shiny Things Island, but they soon realise that it is one big trick by Evil Pea.

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - Veggie Birthday Song
programme.desc: Supertato and the Tato Team have a veggie birthday song for you. Sing and dance along!

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - How to be a Nitwit Superhero Song
programme.desc: Evil Pea is tired of everyone always cheering for Supertato. In this song she looks at all the things that make Supertato super, but realises that she loves being evil!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Duck Badge
programme.desc: The clubhouse is inundated with stray ducklings who think Norrie is their mum, so Duggee and the Squirrels need to do some detective work to reunite them with their real mum.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Day Off Badge
programme.desc: It's Duggee's Day Off but it's not long before the Squirrels show up to tell him about their adventures on their own days off... earning their Day Off badges in the process!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Camouflage Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels meet a chameleon called Cosey and learn about how to blend into their surroundings, earning their Camouflage Badges in the process!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Get Indoors Badge
programme.desc: A weather warning from Duggee's barometer leads the Squirrels to round up all the creatures they can find outside and pile into the clubhouse for an impromptu party.

programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Bad Mood
programme.desc: Bingo is playing Bad Mood with Dad, standing on his feet as Dad stomps around the house, controlling everything Bingo does and causing chaos.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Octopus
programme.desc: When Chloe tries to teach her dad to improvise and play Bluey's game of Octopus at home, he finds it hard to understand or enjoy, until they both realize they can play it their own way.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Bin Night
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Dad always take out the bins. Over a few weeks, Bingo tells Dad about a new kid at kindy who is mean to her and Mum offers some good advice.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Muffin Cone
programme.desc: When Muffin can't stop sucking her thumb, she has to wear a cone of shame. But the cone gets in her way and she can no longer play `sandwich shop' with Bluey and Bingo.

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - Hide-and-Seek, the Giant Pacific Octopus
programme.desc: Bebefinn is playing hide and seek, just like the Giant Pacific Octopus does!

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - Giraffe, The Tallest Animal on Land
programme.desc: Finn and family find out all there is to know about giraffes.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions S01 - Andy and the Baby Kangaroos
programme.desc: In this episode Andy, Jen and Scout head to Australia on a baby animal mission to solve the mystery of why a group of kangaroos, and their joeys, are living on a beach. Along the way, Andy is chased by a pack of dingoes and hops to safety with the baby kangaroos.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Face Painting Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone they think is Enid, only much too big... Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid! Of course, the Squirrels want their faces painted too, so Duggee sets to it.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: Famous Kung Fu Pole master Red Eagle, is kidnapped by a villain one day. His disciple Meng, vows to rescue him. On his way, Meng encounters a greedy but great martial artist who agrees to join him in the rescue. Even though the two have extremely different personalities, they manage to team up and fight the villain in a final showdown.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical "Lucky Casino" and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperor's daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiance Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan...

programme.title: The Thundering Sword
programme.desc: Two disciples, Yu and Zheng, are sent by their master to track down the invincible weapon "Thundering Sword" to prevent villains from getting it. Yu encounters the daughter of a ruthless clan, Chiao, who is on her way to seek for the sword. They quickly fall for each other, but when Chiao accidentally injures Zheng, things become complicated.

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber (1961)
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh's looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet "Classic Beauty".

programme.title: Murder Plot
programme.desc: Martial artist Shen Lang is in discussions with kung fu experts from the other six sects to plot the downfall of the traitorous Happy King when his fiancee suddenly disrupts them and Shen has to quickly bring her away. As they continue to pursue the Happy King, both Shen and his fiancee accidentally fall into a trap set up by the King.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a clever beauty, teams up with her brother to stage a jewel heist and plans to sell the loot in Singapore. To evade customs, she slips a diamond ring into the pocket of a fellow passenger, Zhang Zhi Xian, only to lose him after landing. Forced to track him down, Hua resorts to a series of clumsy schemes to get close and retrieve the ring.

programme.title: That Man In Chang-an
programme.desc: The Han Emperor dies and his Empress Lu seizes the ruling power. She plots to kill the heir to the throne, Liu Heng, but the masked warrior discovers her plot and tips off Liu. Liu sends his princess to Chang An to ask for help. The masked warrior protects the princess from attackers along the way and supports Liu to become the new Emperor.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Fu Hong Xue, a legendary swordsman, travels far to avenge his father, only to find the seven killers he tracks are already dead. Investigating with Yeh Kai, he learns they are alive, manipulated by disguise master Xiao Bie Li, who lures Fu into a trap. Yeh Kai aids him, but both end up trapped in a deadly blade formation.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: Heroes Of Sung stars one of the original kung fu ladies of the silver screen, Shih Szu, who plays swordswoman Meng Hung. She must work with Fan Tien-Fu, played by Lo Lieh to find and protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty. Shih's magnificent performance earned her the female hero role in another hit Dracula And The 7 Golden Vampires.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: Sima works for a corrupt lord Qin who is suffering from a deadly disease that only a special herb can cure. Qin sends him on an urgent mission to retrieve it, but the task is made more difficult when Sima has to fight off other martial artists who want to steal the cure away from him. He has to fight with his ultimate weapon, the Dragon Missile!

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called "Swordswomen Two." Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaw's first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his master's rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gao's betrayal...

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his master's rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gao's betrayal...

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Oath Of Death
programme.desc: Three Sung loyalists become blood brothers to fight the tyranny of the Tartar invaders. To oust the oppressors altogether, Ma releases the kidnapped Tartar princess in a strategic effort to gain points with the invaders, but it soon becomes apparent that he desires both a great position and power, and will do anything to get it...

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Wealthy heir Ping Chien Jen spurns the family business for a travel agency with his girlfriend Su Yung Lan. While they are hosting visitors from Hong Kong, a student falls for Chien Jen, sparking tension. Consumed by jealousy, Yung Lan storms off, and the student crashes her car after learning of his engagement. Misunderstandings are eventually cleared, and happiness follows.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong's caught in the Mong's territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Ping's limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys?

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: A young swordman, King Eagle, unwillingly gets involved in the internal affairs of a powerful clan and becomes their target. He is saved by the female chief of the clan, Lin, and falls in love with her. However, Lin's sister is part of all evil plots and betrays her. Even so, Lin begs King Eagle not to harm her sister.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knight's days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords
programme.desc: Drug lord Jizo joins forces with Mexican cartels, throwing Hong Kong's drug underworld into chaos. Determined to eradicate narcotics, billionaire Yu Shun Tin offers a HK$100 million bounty on drug traffickers while concealing a dark bond with Jizo. As their shared past resurfaces, an explosive showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom. Later, Ying discovers that she is pregnant but no one can remember

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Hail the Judge
programme.desc: A low level magistrate is run out of town for defending a beautiful murder suspect. Through a series of comedic events he ascends to the top rank & returns looking for revenge.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong’s Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai…

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world boxing champion Fai meets the passionate young fighter Qi in Macau and agrees to train him for an upcoming MMA tournament. As mentor and student push themselves to the limit, Fai rediscovers his love for fighting, regains his passion for life, and learns to cherish the people who matter most.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei’s possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: God of Gamblers 2
programme.desc: After the God of Gamblers Ko Chun disappears, his disciple Little Knife rises in the gambling world. His fame attracts a ruthless rival who seeks to defeat him. Facing high-stakes games, Little Knife must rely on his skills to overcome his enemies and defend the honour of the God of Gamblers.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar’s gang when he saves the gang’s elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Jailed for accidental manslaughter, martial arts master Har Hao Mo discovers a killer targeting kung fu masters across Hong Kong. Determined to stop the murders, he helps police track down Fung Yu Sau, a ruthless fighter obsessed with proving his supremacy. As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi’s husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella
programme.desc: Following the chaos unleashed by Pandora’s Box, Joker is thrust through time and begins to awaken as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. Torn between mortal emotions and divine destiny, he struggles to reconcile his love for Zixia Fairy with the responsibilities of his past.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: Guided by mysterious dreams, archaeologist Jack discovers he was General Meng Yi in a past life and shared a tragic love with Princess Ok-Soo that spanned a thousand years. When they reunite in Emperor Qin's celestial palace, a ruthless tycoon seeks the secret of immortality. Reclaiming his past strength, Jack faces a final battle of destiny.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Yat Mei and his disciples live in a remote village until Sister Maria restores an abandoned church, awakening a long-dormant vampire missionary. As panic spreads and Taoist exorcism fails, Yat Mei joins forces with a Western priest, combining Eastern and Western powers to battle evil.

programme.title: Confession of Pain
programme.desc: When the billionaire father-in-law of veteran homicide detective Hei is brutally murdered, Hei's wife, doubting the police investigation, hires his former partner and close friend, private detective Bong, to uncover the truth. As the case takes unexpected twists, Bong discovers the murder is mysteriously linked to Hei.

programme.title: Confession of Pain
programme.desc: When the billionaire father-in-law of veteran homicide detective Hei is brutally murdered, Hei's wife, doubting the police investigation, hires his former partner and close friend, private detective Bong, to uncover the truth. As the case takes unexpected twists, Bong discovers the murder is mysteriously linked to Hei.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong’s biggest stars

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife’s debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian’s daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond…

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Blinded on a counter-terrorism mission, former SWAT captain Dong Gu retires and lives with his daughter. programme.title: EYE台灣精華版第1集
programme.desc: 從人物和食物，看見台灣的美好 吃喝玩樂EYE台灣.

programme.title: 富市台中第3集
programme.desc: 紀錄台中在地文化，呈現台中幸福感！

programme.title: 生活快易通第222集
programme.desc: 節目邀請到大家熟悉的「萬人美老師」－郭昱晴擔任主持人。以系列為節目核心，邀請在相同體系內，受到推崇的精英人士，分享其堅守追求專業的精神與受挫不懈的毅力。並且將依照不同專業，結合生活觀點，推出相符的小單元。內容兼具權威與風趣，不僅拉近觀眾與來賓距離，也從中看到來賓不為人知的另一面。如節目中熱血仁醫系列，除了分享醫生在白色巨塔中奮鬥的故事之外，也會依其專業，在預防醫學的概念下，加入醫療科技新資訊及獨門養生撇步等小單元。

programme.title: 梵音清流第5集
programme.desc: 此音只應天上有，人間哪得幾回聞。」「梵唄」就是清淨之意，除了耳根享受之外，最主要的仍在心靈的清淨，歌詠時還伴以管、弦或敲擊樂器，普及佛教教義。

programme.title: 我的學校有夠酷第5集
programme.desc: 最有趣的學校課程單元探索台灣最酷特色小學， 認識不一樣的學校課程。發掘全台各小學充滿魅力且迷人的特色教學孩子化身為小老師、小職人、小導覽員，分享感受、展現自信與活力主持人沉浸式體驗校園酷趣事及不同面向學習環境，瞭解在地特色民情透過鏡頭，一起跟著孩子們探索台灣的多元文化吧！

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 生活智多星第1866集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－鬱方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，瞭解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 幸福食堂第273集
programme.desc: 由人氣主持人攜手多位蔬食名廚，現場烹調精緻美味的蔬食餐點，讓您大飽眼福，也大飽口福。

programme.title: 人間佛學院第85集

programme.title: 人生調色盤第297集
programme.desc: 歌仔戲小生陳亞蘭小姐首次獨挑大梁，主持深度人物訪談節目【人生調色盤】。 「人生」問題是一門大學問，悲歡離合、生老病死是每個人會經歷的過程，特別是隨著社會發展而衍生出新的問題，例如職場與網路的霸凌、憂鬱症、親人失智長照…等，都是過去所罕見的。 節目透過嘉賓的經驗分享，輔以專家學者從旁論述分析，掌握選擇的思考過程，釐清正確的觀念，藉以產生改變自己的能量。主持人陳亞蘭也發揮歌仔戲隱惡揚善的精神，將「忠孝節義」的處世準則，於節目中傳播出去。 為了推廣台語之美，特別規劃「亞蘭話俗語」單元，每集介紹一句台灣俚俗語，簡單直白卻字字珠璣，不僅學習到老祖宗的智慧，也貼近自己的人生。

programme.title: 熱海戀歌第12集
programme.desc: 父母親早逝的英雄，從小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次鄉裡衝突，英雄和換帖兄弟添財離家北上，進入溫泉鄉~北投，當起限時專送的機車小弟。在北投，他遇見今生唯一的摯愛秀秀。擁有天生音樂才華的他，最初學習各種樂器只是為了討秀秀歡心，最後卻因此成為名揚北投的「春風」那卡西樂團樂手。可惜兩人純真的戀情，卻遭秀秀的養父所反對，英雄卻不放棄；縱使在得知秀秀已與日本商人白原訂婚之後，英雄仍不死心，繼續穿梭在溫泉鄉崎嶇的巷道與繁華的酒宴間，彈著為秀秀所譜寫的未完成歌曲，無畏地向全世界宣誓，他要傾盡一生的光陰來愛秀秀…。在秀秀與白元的婚禮上，英雄衝到美川閣，想帶秀秀遠走高飛！畢竟深愛著英雄的秀秀，身著婚紗、不顧一切坐上他

programme.title: 幸福的起點第4集
programme.desc: 林雅美從小活潑聰明，林父身體不好，雅美從十歲開始學做生意，很快地展現她做生意的天賦，雅美是米行的超級業務員，同時也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什麼事情，天塌下來，總有大姊撐著。 雅美能幹又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是適婚年紀，不過碾米廠家業全仰賴雅美，雅美根本無意出嫁。林父林母緊張，就像米一樣，老米在市場上是沒有競爭力的。父母積極地為雅美安排相親，雅美體貼父母的心意，答應了相親。不過雅美有個但書，她無論如何不要嫁給做生意的人，她已經厭倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要進入婚姻，她只想要找一個老老實實的上班族。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第3集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 大馬慈濟情第718集
programme.desc: 節目內容為馬來西亞當地時事以及慈濟人的報導，透過這些具有啟發性的報導、愛的消息，帶領觀眾深入人文道理，見證慈悲等人文知識，進一步帶領觀眾啟發善念，淨化人心。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 幸福的起點第4集
programme.desc: 林雅美從小活潑聰明，林父身體不好，雅美從十歲開始學做生意，很快地展現她做生意的天賦，雅美是米行的超級業務員，同時也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什麼事情，天塌下來，總有大姊撐著。 雅美能幹又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是適婚年紀，不過碾米廠家業全仰賴雅美，雅美根本無意出嫁。林父林母緊張，就像米一樣，老米在市場上是沒有競爭力的。父母積極地為雅美安排相親，雅美體貼父母的心意，答應了相親。不過雅美有個但書，她無論如何不要嫁給做生意的人，她已經厭倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要進入婚姻，她只想要找一個老老實實的上班族。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第2集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: TRY科學第34集
programme.desc: 你我的生活小問號，可能成就科學大發現。所以號召全民try科學，活化每個人潛在的科學基因。 生雞蛋握掌心，為什麼連壯漢都捏不破？！ 一片口香糖，要怎麼開啟沒拉環的易開罐？ 科學基因不限男女老幼貧富貴賤，科學現象不分校園、街頭、辦公室或客廳，Try科學想戳醒你不找答案不行的好奇心。 Try科學以放大生活中各種有趣現象為誘因，以主持人科學機智問答的闖關設計，透過科學MAN吸引眼球的科學實驗與找答案的邏輯推理……讓科學接地氣，讓科學活用在生活裡。

programme.title: 蔬果生活誌第217集
programme.desc: 關於「吃」，該怎麼吃得有智慧、吃出健康和營養呢？ 瞭解台灣不同時節、氣候的豐富物產，透過農人的智慧和汗水，告訴您食材的生命故事，並且體驗背後的價值與感動。

programme.title: 人文講堂第499集
programme.desc: 《人文講堂》節目，邀請台灣各行各業傑出人士、學者專家，或熱愛生命者，將多年的學識涵養、人文感受，以及對生命的活力，以講演方式，直接與大眾分享。講演的內容及方式，不再流於傳統，不僅是知識或專業技術而已，更會呈現出特有的人文觀點。

programme.title: 愛重生第5集
programme.desc: 張基龍師兄事業有成經營電器事業，但無常考驗不斷，89年長子博堯車禍身亡，兩年後女兒瓊文也因車禍重度昏迷。兒女的情況讓基龍心情極度沮喪。因為上人一句「要用心」，基龍毅然結束事業專心照料女兒。女兒身體漸漸恢復健康，因見證大林醫院大愛農場的成效，也效法成立農場提供病人專心復健。

programme.title: 情比姊妹深第1集
programme.desc: 黎蘭章出生於南部農家，從小跟著父親做農，結婚後家庭幸福美滿，孰料先生早逝，她獨力撫養兩個孩子，這段期間蘭章受到朋友同事的關心與照顧，才能度過人生的低潮，為了回饋社會的愛心，蘭章加入了慈濟。因受到上人的感召，蘭章自認文的不會，武的也不會，只會做環保。蘭章十幾年不感動許多志工紛紛加入，但困難的是始終沒有固定的環保點，她的堅持與不退，感動了麗梅師姊，提供固定的場地給蘭章做環保，也終於不用再流浪。她們用做環保來實踐上人的法，也吸引了很多志工加入，蘭章跟麗梅認為環保道場就是人間淨土，也是她們及志工們的心靈修道場。

programme.title: 行動現場第565集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
台灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是台灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散佈各鄉鎮村裡，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平台，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.title: 青春愛讀書第259集
programme.desc: 青春愛讀書 開啟年輕閱讀新風潮 青春愛讀書，看年輕人讀什麼書！

programme.title: 證嚴上人說故事第282集
programme.desc: 聽故事，曾經是兒時最大的期待。好聽的故事，更是百聽不厭、刻骨銘心。 《證嚴上人說故事》是證嚴上人從多年生活歷練中摘取得來的智慧結晶。在一則則風趣淺白故事中，她告訴我們，在生命的經營裡，如果被『名』枷『利』鎖綁住，而失去心靈空間，那將是一種無法彌補的損失。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 生活地球村第294集

programme.title: 大馬慈濟情第650集
programme.desc: 節目內容為馬來西亞當地時事以及慈濟人的報導，透過這些具有啟發性的報導、愛的消息，帶領觀眾深入人文道理，見證慈悲等人文知識，進一步帶領觀眾啟發善念，淨化人心。

programme.title: 風月同天第49集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 證嚴上人說法華第26集
programme.desc: 彙整歷年法藏，重現智慧法語。《證嚴上人說法華》精選晨語開示，提綱挈領導讀《法華經》核心精神。此經譽為諸經之王，上人致力將深奧教義化為現代「菩薩道」，以實踐足跡印證經文，強調「不只誦經，更要行經」。透過濃縮法要，引領大眾深入淺出體悟教菩薩法，讓歷久彌新的法髓延續靈山感動，回歸清淨本性。

programme.title: 婆羅浮屠第3集
programme.desc: 婆羅浮屠以一千四百六十幅佛典浮雕，見證印尼佛教文明與宗教共融。歷經沉寂與修復，至今仍傳遞覺悟、行善與人道精神。

programme.title: 志為人醫守護愛2.0第163集
programme.desc:
什麼是有溫度的醫療？什麼是醫療之魂？醫療團隊除了在診間、在手術室、在病房搶救生命之外，還能做些什麼？
『志為人醫守護愛』帶您目擊動人的溫馨醫病情現場，透過醫療團隊的視病如親、 以病為師的堅持、病患與醫療團隊的互相感恩，體會與感受現代人醫如何幫助病患重拾信心，在他們人生低潮時重新出發，進而走入人群，自助助人。

programme.title: 行動現場第566集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
台灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是台灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散佈各鄉鎮村裡，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平台，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.title: 愛重生第5集
programme.desc: 張基龍師兄事業有成經營電器事業，但無常考驗不斷，89年長子博堯車禍身亡，兩年後女兒瓊文也因車禍重度昏迷。兒女的情況讓基龍心情極度沮喪。因為上人一句「要用心」，基龍毅然結束事業專心照料女兒。女兒身體漸漸恢復健康，因見證大林醫院大愛農場的成效，也效法成立農場提供病人專心復健。

programme.title: 情比姊妹深第1集
programme.desc: 黎蘭章出生於南部農家，從小跟著父親做農，結婚後家庭幸福美滿，孰料先生早逝，她獨力撫養兩個孩子，這段期間蘭章受到朋友同事的關心與照顧，才能度過人生的低潮，為了回饋社會的愛心，蘭章加入了慈濟。因受到上人的感召，蘭章自認文的不會，武的也不會，只會做環保。蘭章十幾年不感動許多志工紛紛加入，但困難的是始終沒有固定的環保點，她的堅持與不退，感動了麗梅師姊，提供固定的場地給蘭章做環保，也終於不用再流浪。她們用做環保來實踐上人的法，也吸引了很多志工加入，蘭章跟麗梅認為環保道場就是人間淨土，也是她們及志工們的心靈修道場。

programme.title: 映照人生第526集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大。由印尼大愛台製作的「映照人生」，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一。 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容。 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 守護大自然第1集
programme.desc: 印尼原住民族世代與自然共存，以傳統智慧守護森林、海洋與土地。面對開發變遷，仍堅守文化及生態平衡，為後代留下珍貴傳承。

programme.title: 大愛全紀實第198集
programme.desc: 慈濟四大八法推廣與傳播,關注地球與人類永續發展議題。 解讀近代事件中，慈濟「曾經」參與的足跡，至今「正在」持續的行動，以及留給「未來」的影響力。 為觀眾傳播慈濟四大八法，剖析探討慈濟人如何關注地球永續發展、推動拔苦予樂的希望工程。

programme.title: 人文講堂第610集
programme.desc: 《人文講堂》節目，邀請台灣各行各業傑出人士、學者專家，或熱愛生命者，將多年的學識涵養、人文感受，以及對生命的活力，以講演方式，直接與大眾分享。講演的內容及方式，不再流於傳統，不僅是知識或專業技術而已，更會呈現出特有的人文觀點。

programme.desc: 慈濟四大八法推廣與傳播,關注地球與人類永續發展議題。 解讀近代事件中，慈濟「曾經」參與的足跡，至今「正在」持續的行動，以及留給「未來」的影響力。 為觀眾傳播慈濟四大八法，剖析探討慈濟人如何關注地球永續發展、推動拔苦予樂的希望工程。

programme.title: 行動現場第566集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
台灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是台灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散佈各鄉鎮村裡，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平台，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第618集
programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第2113集
programme.desc: 大陸尋奇是台灣目前最社教節目之冠不惜巨資的大製作足跡踏遍各現代城市、窮鄉僻壤，深入各民族村落，記錄了外人難得一見的生活情況，以準確的地理、歷史定位，用現代化思維，把中華文化忠實的呈現。 漫遊在浩瀚中國的世外桃源，細賞湖光山色間的粉妝玉琢，帶您跋山涉水遊遍奇峰峻嶺，讓您看盡壯闊山河嘆為觀止。

programme.desc: 故事講述一個在台灣北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父親不切實際地為這個家帶來債務、困擾與紛爭。時常失蹤的父親只能由任勞任怨的母親咬牙把這個家支撐下去。多年後四處飄浪的父親癌末回來找長大後的女兒，女兒為了處理父親的臨終把本已瓦解的家庭關係，再次找回分散各地家人，並在父親臨終前相互道歉、和解道別。

programme.desc: 「中視午間新聞」每天以最客觀的角度，最專業的主播，為觀眾完整報導上午發生之重大國內外重要新聞，並提供最新股市收盤價格。

programme.title: 中視強檔電影院-X檔案-征服未來第17集
programme.desc: 講述 FBI 特探員穆德與史卡莉在 X 檔案部門遭關閉後，因調查一起建築物爆炸案，意外揭發政府高層試圖掩蓋「外星人即將殖民地球」的驚天陰謀。

programme.title: 台灣味道7第6集
programme.desc: 深入台灣各地鄉野探尋珍寶美味與在地文化，內容扣人心絃、發人深省。

programme.title: 60分鐘第361集
programme.desc: 由主播黃國瑋主持的新聞雜誌節目，深入探討新聞時事與議題，將帶給你全方位的報導。

programme.title: 飢餓遊戲第506集
programme.desc: 每天都是新的挑戰，你永遠不知道下一關會和誰合作，所以只能帶著「持續遊戲、持續進食」的心態，努力獲得食物來滿足飢餓，直到飢餓指數歸零，這樣才能成為最終的勝利者！

programme.title: 中視新聞全球報導第31集

programme.title: 綜藝一級棒第123集
programme.desc: 希望在最美好的舞台上，給大家帶來滿滿歡樂時光！

programme.title: 綜藝玩很大第598集
programme.desc: ｢綜藝玩很大｣由亞洲娛樂天王吳宗憲、小鬼黃鴻升主持， 每集任務關卡無極限，來賓個個拚得你死我活， 不只玩很大，更跟你玩真的， 到底藝人們為了輸贏能多犧牲？ 中視週六晚上10點【綜藝玩很大】

programme.title: 霹靂朝靈闕第26集
programme.desc: 猂劫兵烽，無暇暗劫起，猂族利用地獄鳥力量，動盪苦境之後，雌伏多年的暗劫八無暇，也趁勢再出，為阻止這股邪惡勢力顛覆中原武林，湯問夢澤山座白象．香六牙，廣發天下舉鋒帖，召開擎天會，聚集西窗月、墨如鴉、不全鷹等湯問英傑，正心六崇越宗主巍翼、太叔望，以及儒道釋代表相繼響應，血漫河山俠骨烈，亙古之爭，勝敗由天抑由人？

programme.title: 100種不老生活第42集
programme.desc: 從「生活的角度」出發，關心不同族群與不同世代，究竟這些前輩們都去哪裡? 做什麼? 說什麼? 「100種不老生活」融合生活中多重方面的知識性及娛樂性，探討樂齡學習的有趣過程，紀錄他們的生命故事，感受他們不老精神，製作樂活無畏的生活節目，讓你我的日常更加豐富精采

programme.title: 霹靂俠影之轟霆劍海錄第60集
programme.desc: 神州動盪，武林危難，森獄大舉入侵，逆海崇帆滅亡，黑海森獄崛起，玄囂太子領導眾多強將，一舉攻陷武林。同為皇儲，玄滅太子也伺機而出，與玄囂一爭苦境版圖，要將森獄版圖擴張至苦境，完成個人霸業，以便未來繼承閻王之位。道門六傑挺身而出，倦收天與銀驃當家等攜手抵抗，唯慕崢嶸私心自用，導致無辜傷亡，最終遭受制裁惡有惡報。而玄滅也在過程中敗亡，留下玄囂太子，延續葬天關魔城擴張的計畫，最終對上倦收天與銀驃當家。森獄潛伏的勢力崛起，大太子玄臏協同蛻變黑後，兩人暗中關注著玄囂太子的一切行為，伺機而作。而一生執著於劍道的玄同，也因為論劍海的評劍會，踏入苦 境，追尋屬於自己的劍道。究竟是誰的劍？能給予惋紅曲追尋的答案。

programme.title: 天子傳奇第17集
programme.desc: 商朝第二十八代君－紂王，好大喜功，徵戰連連，百姓為其榷稅徵租，貧乏窮困，哀聲載道，民心漸失。一日在平魔的慶功宴時，代表大商國運的鎮國龍龜猝亡，適時西現紫氣，紂王視為必是西出妖孽，足以禍國，便遣妖帥調領大軍征剿西岐。 西伯侯姬昌第二子名曰姬發，出世時天空出現異象，百姓皆稱其為未來聖主。姬昌算易知悉姬發有九九之命格危在旦夕，便挺險施行九鼎奇法，卻因妖帥與九大護衛殺入，反成九五至尊之數。大祭司見弄巧成拙，建請紂王宣召姬發上京面聖，藉機要將姬發煉製靈人，代替護國祥物，紂王為保王命，想盡辦法不擇手段，導致天怒人怨，因此種下亡國敗運的禍根。 姬發面聖路上，災劫連連，有飄渺城之困，卻因禍得福習得「渾天寶

programme.desc: 商朝第二十八代君－紂王，好大喜功，徵戰連連，百姓為其榷稅徵租，貧乏窮困，哀聲載道，民心漸失。一日在平魔的慶功宴時，代表大商國運的鎮國龍龜猝亡，適時西現紫氣，紂王視為必是西出妖孽，足以禍國，便遣妖帥調領大軍征剿西岐。 西伯侯姬昌第二子名曰姬發，出世時天空出現異象，百姓皆稱其為未來聖主。姬昌算易知悉姬發有九九之命格危在旦夕，便挺險施行九鼎奇法，卻因妖帥與九大護衛殺入，反成九五至尊之數。大祭司見弄巧成拙，建請紂王宣召姬發上京面聖，藉機要將姬發煉製靈人，代替護國祥物，紂王為保王命，想盡辦法不擇手段，導致天怒人怨，因此種下亡國敗運的禍根。 姬發面聖路上，災劫連連，有飄渺城之困，卻因禍得福習得「渾天寶

programme.title: 霹靂朝靈闕第27集
programme.desc: 猂劫兵烽，無暇暗劫起，猂族利用地獄鳥力量，動盪苦境之後，雌伏多年的暗劫八無暇，也趁勢再出，為阻止這股邪惡勢力顛覆中原武林，湯問夢澤山座白象．香六牙，廣發天下舉鋒帖，召開擎天會，聚集西窗月、墨如鴉、不全鷹等湯問英傑，正心六崇越宗主巍翼、太叔望，以及儒道釋代表相繼響應，血漫河山俠骨烈，亙古之爭，勝敗由天抑由人？

programme.title: 新霹靂英雄榜第170集
programme.desc: 《新霹靂英雄榜》是一部動作冒險型別的電視劇或電影系列，為霹靂布袋戲的新一代作品。故事背景設定在一個神秘的武林世界，充滿了武術、魔法和神秘力量。故事圍繞著一群英雄人物展開，他們各自擁有獨特的技能和身世背景。他們將面臨來自黑暗勢力和邪惡組織的威脅，必須團結一致，通過戰鬥和冒險來守護正義和保護世界的平衡。《新霹靂英雄榜》融合了激烈的打鬥場面、刺激的動作場景和細膩的角色發展，帶給觀眾一場震撼的視覺盛宴。劇情扣人心絃，充滿著驚險、奇幻和神秘的元素，同時也融入了人物之間的情感和義務的探討。這部作品以霹靂布袋戲的獨特風格和特色為基礎，結合了現代特效和技術，將傳統和現代元素相結合，呈現出一個全新的霹靂世界。觀

programme.title: 土地公傳奇第157集
programme.desc: 玉帝賜封的土地公（廖峻飾），原是民間稅官，因他是凡人不會做神，玉帝就在神界選了一個既漂亮又聰明的仙女（陳亞蘭飾）做他的妻子，好協助他。這位仙女是都海城隍爺（陸一龍飾）的三女兒。土地公土地婆下界為神，土地公有求必應，為民間百姓多做善事，藉助城隍爺身邊文判官（施羽飾）、武判官（黃仲裕飾）的神界力量。

programme.title: 包青天第106集
programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。

programme.desc: 1947 年台北，228 事件爆發，19 歲的木村被情人藏匿於劇場，與神秘女子和田涼意外共處一室。她自稱記得兩人的未來，認為「未來是記憶，過去才是未來」，木村困惑卻深受吸引。1967 年東京，木村奉命招降異議份子陳光， 並與酷似和田涼的女子墜入愛河，這次他終於相信兩人命運相繫，卻也意識到兩人終將分離。1987 年台北，木村與17 歲的和田涼重逢，這回換他堅信她的秘密，反是和田涼遲疑該不該相信這名「木村老先生」的故事。時光無情流轉，戀人如何跨越時空法則，尋回彼此？

programme.title: 遇見祝福第5集

programme.title: 真情部落格第331集
programme.desc: 自2005年開播以來，《真情部落格》已訪問數百位生命勇士。當這些勇士面對生命中的困難時，他們選擇依靠對耶穌的信心，勇敢地克服挑戰。這些可愛的基督徒願意與大家分享他們生命中最黑暗、最脆弱的一面，目的是將來自天上的美好福分帶給人們。每一個充滿血淚的生命見證都是令人震撼的轉變，帶來最深刻的真實感。

programme.title: 福氣人生第749集
programme.desc: 要擁有福氣人生，可以透過聆聽牧師們以台語分享聖經的真理，讓你領受天國滿滿的福氣與祝福。這些牧師們將以深入淺出的方式解釋聖經，將其應用於當代生活，讓你明白神的心意和計劃。通過聆聽台語講道，你可以更深入地理解聖經的教導，並在日常生活中實踐。這些講道將提供實際的指引和智慧，幫助你在家庭、工作、人際關係等各個領域經歷神的福氣。聆聽這樣的講道，你將能夠領悟到屬天的價值觀和生活方式，學習依靠聖靈的帶領，活出基督徒的身份和見證。這將使你能夠更深入地體驗神的愛和恩典，並將其傳遞給他人。

programme.title: 恩典365第1597集

programme.title: 天堂敬拜第59集

programme.title: 700俱樂部第394集

programme.title: 藝術二分之一-Art kak’I’iyaeh第2季:第13集
programme.desc: 以原住民族群的生活樣貌，引導觀眾重新認識我們與自然之間的深厚聯絡。節目以元素為主題，解鎖新興樣貌的原住民藝術家，展現如何從土地中取得靈感並將其轉化為多元族群的藝術形式。藝術的一半來自創作，另一半則透過觀眾的感受與詮釋得以完整，體現藝術共享的精神，同時展現永續與共生的創作理念。

programme.title: 原視晚安報新聞第304集
programme.desc: 原視晚安報新聞，提供最新、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題，讓觀眾在午後休息時，獲得及時且可靠的資訊，瞭解當日發生的重要事件和動態。

programme.title: 來去部落kivala-新春特輯第5集
programme.desc: kivala在排灣語為拜訪之意，節目要邀請觀眾朋友跟著在地族人腳步，找尋動人有趣的故事，一同kivala ！

programme.title: 暗夜新聞第302集
programme.desc: 暗夜客話新聞是全國唯一主播、記者以全客語發音的新聞頻道，並 詳實顯示字幕，除了著眼於「客家觀點」的重要新聞議題、呈現客家生活 習俗與傳統文化之外，更盡力發掘社會各階層客家鄉親的故事。暗夜客話新聞針對四節新聞播出鏡面，以桐花、藍衫等各種不同主題的客家元素為基礎，作全面的視覺設計，讓收視大眾們能夠耳目一新、零時差的掌握，最具客家觀點的新聞呈現。

programme.title: 無形英雄第8集
programme.desc: 故事從龍隊14年來主力重炮手柳澤博人開始；柳澤博人自球員生涯開始，就是場上耀眼焦點，直到近年陷入低潮挫折，博人因壓力而常在鎂光燈下流露負面情緒，又再接到球團不續約通知後，人生更是跌落低谷深淵，就當自己都泛起放棄的念頭時，一通求助電話，反而燃起博人對棒球的熱情，也更發現，真正的棒球，不是隻有強力揮擊而已…

programme.title: 訊號測試
programme.desc: 客家電視台訊號測試

programme.title: 日頭下‧月光光第97集
programme.desc: 此齣為與生活資訊結合的客家戲劇，客語口說藝術的劇場，其中包含了相聲竹板快書、以及說文解字，用活潑逗趣的表演方式，來傳達客家語言，敬請觀眾鎖定收看！

programme.title: 國際新聞-客觀世界第295集
programme.desc: 是一個專注於國際時事的新聞節目，以客觀、中立的角度報導全球各地的重要新聞事件。節目內容涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的議題，旨在向觀眾傳遞真實可信的消息，讓觀眾全面瞭解世界各地的動態，增進對國際事務的理解和視野。

programme.title: 停動停動好健康第250集
programme.desc: 《停動停動好健康》是一個關注身體健康的節目，通過介紹和推廣健康的生活方式和運動方法，鼓勵觀眾在日常生活中停下腳步，注重運動和健康飲食，增進身體健康和心靈幸福，提高生活質量。這個節目旨在激發觀眾對健康的關注和重視，讓人們更好地照顧自己的身心健康。

programme.title: 奧林p客第1632集
programme.desc: 在新的對話中，主持人和機器人阿藍妹將增加科技互動的元素。參賽孩子們將扮演小博士的角色，從各種主題和發明中學習現代科學和未來科技。每一集將以「一大六小」的競賽形式進行，並引入四選一的卡牌抽選機制，讓孩子們學習團隊合作，並在面對不同意見時學會溝通和做出抉擇。

programme.title: Bilibolo唱唱跳跳第639集
programme.desc: 為了讓客語深入生活，提供一個屬於小朋友的舞台，讓小朋友透過表演創作來學習客語，並鼓勵更多客語腔調表演，呈現出不同客語腔調文化特色，展現出客家多元腔調之美。

programme.title: 客家戲曲第1199集
programme.desc: 由多個著名客家劇團，分別演出相當膾炙人口的小說故事，希望能讓大家再次回味童年看戲的滋味，也能讓更多人欣賞到客家的傳統大戲。

programme.title: 世紀的寶貝第62集
programme.desc: 本節目介紹一些客籍人士的珍藏，以及他們本身為客家文化所做的努力，藉由他們的故事來瞭解他們的偉大。

programme.title: 福氣來了(南方篇)第113集
programme.desc: 《福氣來了 南方篇》將延伸至中南部及花東地區，透過節目提供平台，讓鄉親朋友能夠走進攝影棚，分享他們的故事，並進行互相交流。在東南部的客家莊裡，我們能夠欣賞到獨特的生活方式，美麗如畫的田園風光以及多元的文化。讓我們在這個地方，暢談鄉親們的人生故事。

programme.title: 一家之煮第542集
programme.desc: 走訪客莊邀請兩組家庭進行對決，藉由家人間的默契一起做料理，品嚐彼此完成的美食，進而帶領觀眾瞭解「感動人」的客家文化及地方特色食材或時令蔬果。

programme.title: 學學嘴學學鼻MV時間第21集
programme.desc: 孩子牙牙學語的模樣，是所有父母最鮮明的親子時光，而我們客家人有一個詞，生動描述了這個過程：「學嘴學鼻」。全新推出的幼兒節目《學學嘴學學鼻》，就是從這四個字延伸而來的創意。我們塑造了兩位默劇小丑，逆向操作了大人教孩子的邏輯，反過來用畫面外的孩子，一字一句教小丑說客語，小丑則會搭配幽默逗趣的肢體語言，呈現每集要學習的關鍵字。

programme.title: 森林偵探隊Ⅲ(詔安腔)第18集
programme.desc: 延續前兩季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更額外增加了新的冒險夥伴阿莉、阿新牯、卡卡。面對接踵而來的森林任務，大家勇敢、熱心且不畏艱難地向彼此伸出援手，儘管過程中充滿挑戰，卻也能在每次的行動中獲得意想不到的收穫

programme.title: ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕(詔安腔)第194集
programme.desc: 「ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕」是一部描述四位好朋友的故事的節目。在這個節目中，朋友們會有對話、爭吵、歡笑，並共同編織出一連串有趣的故事情節。

programme.title: 邊緣人第4集
programme.desc: 紀錄片審視了生活在兩國邊境鮮為人知的邊界上的人們，在獨特的環境中為生存和繁榮而奮鬥。

programme.title: 當晝新聞第303集
programme.desc: 《當晝新聞》是一個日間新聞節目，提供即時、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題。這個節目專注於在白天時段向觀眾傳遞當下最重要的新聞資訊，讓觀眾隨時掌握時事動向，並對眾多議題保持關注和理解。無論是政治動盪、經濟變化，或者社會事件和文化創新，這個節目都將為觀眾帶來最及時的報導和解析。

programme.title: 飛越客莊第20集
programme.desc: 藉助一套先進的高機動無人機裝置，我們能夠輕鬆模擬飛鳥俯瞰的視角，以優雅的姿態穿梭於繁華的街道和幽靜的小巷，完整紀錄下台灣客莊的人文風情和自然景觀。這套裝置擁有各種變幻莫測的攝影角度，能夠生動地呈現客莊所發生的故事，並以獨特的視角展現現代客家文化的發展脈絡。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第13集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道「南路鷹一萬死九千」這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味。很湊巧的，「生趣」這兩個字，其實這是客語「有趣」的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是「大自然真有趣」。這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿、旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍
